messages:
Maddie H.: Quick sync re: AuburnAI private/VPC onboarding — customer reports gaps in audit logs for inference endpoints over the last ~6h. SOC is concerned and renewal conversation is next week. Can we confirm whether logs are leaving our side? https://go/runbooks/auburn-onboard
Priya K.: On it. I'm on the 1p PT call. What we see so far: s3 delivery latency spikes and some objects without KMS encryption metadata.
Kyra L.: I'll start host-side checks. Maddie, can you drop a sample event ID?
Maddie H.: sample: "2026-03-20T18:03:12Z - PutObject - bucket: auburn-logs-prod - x-amz-server-side-encryption: null" (redacted id: a3f2c9)
Josh R.: Possible forwarder role missing kms:Decrypt after a key rollover. I'll pull KMS rotation + CloudTrail logs now.
Samir V.: Flagging renewal risk. If SOC can't get tamper-proof logs they may request credits. Let's prioritize.
eng-deploy-bot: Deployment checker: last agent heartbeat auburn-vpc-agent-2 @ 2026-03-20T17:58:45Z — status: healthy.
Kyra L.: I see the forwarder uses role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rdw-logs-forwarder-auburn. Its inline policy does NOT include kms:Decrypt for CMK alias/rdw/auburn. Opening infra ticket.
Josh R.: Also double-check whether the customer is using client-side encryption — that would explain the null SSE header. If they are SSE-KMS server-side, then it's on our forwarder.
Maddie H.: Priya — can you confirm with Auburn about client-side vs server-side encryption on the call? If it's client-side we need different handling.
Priya K.: Confirmed on the call: they use server-side SSE-KMS. They also provided a manifest showing ~14 missing objects in the last 6h. They asked for 13 months retention, annual KMS rotation, and proof playback for the last 30 days for audit.
Samir V.: From security: we should produce a signed proof bundle for a 30-day window (S3 manifests + KMS metadata + CloudTrail events). If we missed objects, document gaps and remediation steps.
Kyra L.: Created INFRA-4821. Plan: (1) add kms:Decrypt to forwarder role (PR + review), (2) validate agent memory (we saw OOMs last week), (3) re-run delivery job for the missing window. ETA for PR: ~2 hours.
Maddie H.: I'll tell customer we have a plan + ETA. Marking renewal_risk_level=medium until playback validated.
Josh R.: Config snippet that is likely missing from forwarder IAM policy:
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": [
    "kms:Decrypt",
    "kms:GenerateDataKey"
  ],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"
}
```
Priya K.: On call they confirmed server-side SSE-KMS, so the missing header is from our forwarder. I'm uploading their manifest to the INFRA ticket.
Kyra L.: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1298 — adds policy change + deployment job to restart forwarder.
eng-deploy-bot: CI for PR passed. Merge scheduled in 10m.
Samir V.: After merge, Ops: run integrity checks — verify S3 object headers, KMS Decrypt events by forwarder role in CloudTrail, and Splunk ingest counts.
Maddie H.: Also capture customer feedback: they want proactive alerts when log delivery drops below threshold. Suggest adding a delta alert and a short runbook for audit log recovery for renewal.
Priya K.: Will capture both asks and draft the runbook to share with customer.
Maddie H.: Action owners: Kyra (INFRA-4821), Josh (KMS rotation verification), Samir (security proof bundle), Priya (customer comms + runbook). Check-in here in 3h. :thumbsup:
